maintenance_owner: Rust differential harness and execution-adapter maintainers

qualification.statement: Every declared gate step exited 0 except flake. flake failed its repository check; runtime subject binding does not make it a pass. v8 was installed from the release build of the tree the gates hashed at start and end; the pin step refused any tree difference before or during pinning.

repairs.statement: A wrapper launch without a source file stays a tool probe whatever crate types it names; a proc-macro compile of a source file stays a host compile.
A receive with a timeout fails with EINTR when a signal interrupts it. The collector treated that as fatal, closed its socket and lost every later frame; it now retries.

scratch_target_attempt.cause: In a scratch target directory the zstd-sys build script reran under the gate CC/AR settings and failed with EACCES overwriting read-only headers it had copied; rerun in the gate target directory.

run.harness_revision_reason: Fresh immutable cohort after the wait-collector interrupted-receive repair: a signal-interrupted receive is retried instead of ending capture. Unchanged strict compiler-process, forced-reentry, population, fault and equality requirements and all seven stage options; data root kept short so wait sockets fit SUN_LEN.

summary.policy: Only explicit real clean compiles and bounded child probes executed; derived adversarial observations are labelled policy injections, not compiler outputs. The ordinary matrix remains unrun/nonpassing here. Crash/cancel require the baseline command's separate actual fault campaign.

v7_all_stages.statement: Six stages qualified. The cohorts stage exited 1: one measured chain-warm sample lost one wait record after all nine of its frames arrived, so its pair was excluded as work_unqualified. A clean-reference compile and one warm-up build each lost one record after all of their frames.

summary.policy: five alternating AB/BA same-instrumentation baseline replay pairs per fixture/cache; median/min/max; no percentiles; OS page cache and affinity uncontrolled; no speedup claim

v7_cohorts_rerun.statement: The cohorts stage alone on the same v7 executables qualified, while one chain-incremental warm-up build recorded no frame and eight dropped records: one capture loss plus seven current units left without a binding. Every v7 loss has the shape an interrupted receive produced before the repair (one dropped record, no frame after it), which the regression test reproduces; the v7 executables carry that behavior.

prior_record.superseded_by: Every stage reran on executables built after both wait-capture repairs.

non_claims: Qualification covers the admitted fixtures, options and cohort only; it is not general Cargo or pipelining equivalence.
The signal that interrupted the v7 receives was not identified; the repair makes capture independent of it.
No speedup, timing, compiler-correctness or acceptance claim; no checkbox changed.
The v13 flake repository check failed; successful runtime stages do not qualify the whole gate.
